presets.name: Conservative 2R
presets.description: Fixed target at twice the initial risk. No trailing, no partials — the whole position rides to one level or the original stop, whichever comes first.

presets.name: Aggressive ATR Trail
presets.description: Starts trailing as soon as the trade is barely in profit and follows closely — gives back little of an extended move, but is readily stopped out by ordinary noise.

presets.name: Quick Scalp
presets.description: A small fixed target, or out after four bars regardless — whichever comes first. For setups meant to resolve almost immediately.

presets.name: Swing Partial Ladder
presets.description: Scales out half the position at 1R and a quarter at 2R, moves the remainder to breakeven once 1R is reached, then trails the final quarter behind swing structure.

presets.name: Session Close
presets.description: No price target at all — flat by the close of the New York session, win or lose. For strategies that reason about one session and should not carry risk into the next.

presets.name: Breakeven Runner
presets.description: Protects at breakeven once 1R is reached, then hands over to a wider ATR trail from 2R onward. No fixed target — the whole position is either stopped at breakeven or left to run.

presets.name: Structure Trail
presets.description: The stop follows the nearest confirmed swing from the first bar, unconditionally — no activation threshold, no fixed target. Rides the position for as long as market structure supports it.

presets.name: Time Boxed
presets.description: No price-based exit beyond the original stop. Closed after twenty bars regardless of where price is — for setups whose thesis has a shelf life.
